set.body:
Purpose:
Freeze the semantic and compatibility contract before changing error or effect types.

Scope:
- Add a durable BIDS hardening plan under docs/plans and link it from the BIDS README or module map.
- Inventory the public BIDS constructors/loaders and live consumers in dataset, motion, fmri-workflow, and dataset-zarr.
- Classify operations as pure parsing, independent validation, fatal access, recoverable dataset diagnostics, or effectful adapter work.
- Specify stable BidsIssue codes/severities/context, deterministic ordering, and strict versus collect-and-continue policy.
- Freeze compatibility expectations for BidsManifest.fromRelativePaths, BidsProjectLoader.load, query constructors, confound strategies, and event-table readers.
- Record the Cats Core and Cats Effect admission criteria, version compatibility, public-API exposure policy, and removal criteria.

Acceptance:
- The plan names exact APIs and migration behavior rather than saying broadly to adopt Cats.
- Baseline evidence records 52 JVM and 45 Scala.js BIDS tests passing.
- Every later child has an explicit dependency and a falsifiable acceptance gate.
- No implementation dependency is added in this slice.
set.title: BIDS F0: freeze validation and effect-boundary contract
